milestones.topic: PMAPFIX internal-boot panic resolution and R32-ELSQWAIT / R32-PCFIX2 8/8 Geekbench 6 Metal breakthrough
milestones.summary: Decoded AAPL,PanicInfo0000..0003 (d1c3e3018b832b524cd3a7df730de77428f372222540c8a42e6d29ec11b628e6) identified pmap_recycle_page at 0x101310000; reserving 0x101000000..0x101400000 (4 MiB) under UEFI -> ReservedMemory with debug=0x100000 eliminated pmap_recycle_page panics across all 28 subsequent trials. Unconditional elsqWait, GEN8_ROW_CHICKEN2 (0xe4f4=0xc100c100), CS_CHICKEN1 (0x2580=0x00020002), and hpSanitizeComputeEncoder (R32-PCFIX2, NootedGreen SHA-256 f52f0d44d304e55e95b9875adb2c198b0950578b0ce4cc07191cc534962b1a54) completed all 8 Geekbench 6.5.0 Metal workloads (25,088 encoders) with 0 GPU hangs and 0 GPURestart, deployed to internal NVMe /boot/EFI/OC.
milestones.limitation: Multi-run back-to-back endurance testing was subsequently completed in R32-PCFIX3..R32-PCFIX27.

milestones.topic: 100% Three-Stage GPU Stability & Endurance Pass (R32-PCFIX27-PMAPFIX, 705,024 compute encoders, 0 hangs) & Internal NVMe /boot/EFI/OC Deployment
milestones.summary: Implemented lossless Single-Port RCS Execlist scheduling (PCFIX6, 0 Port1 submissions, 0 LITE_RESTORE, 0 0x40002098 freezes, 100% clean XeNG GPUREC: reset RCS ret=1 recovery); verified 5/5 DualSubslices (80 EU) 0xffffffff idle completion in PCFIX22..PCFIX26; persisted CS_DBG1=00000010 and CHKN3=00002000 across context switches via 64-bit shifted _WA_TABLE bits 0xf5f|=0x80 and 0xf68|=0x01 in PCFIX25/PCFIX26; and in R32-PCFIX27 (NootedGreen SHA-256 56c2d0758770803190b70b897e06b1ed5ab5318df97fef0c1fc4c07a2de2ffd9, UUID 4C4C44D2-5555-3144-A1F9-D192CDF39360), preserved ResetPreambleCmds Packet 1 (dw[+1]=0x001010a0U before PIPELINE_SELECT=GPGPU) while changing Packet 3 (dw[+19] after MEDIA_STATE_FLUSH in GPGPU mode) to 0x001000a0U on the clean PCFIX20 baseline, passing 100% of all three stages of the Real-Machine GPU Stability & Endurance Test Plan (Stage 1: 3 consecutive full Geekbench 6.5.0 Metal runs, 24 workloads, enc=75,264; Stage 2: 90s 4-worker concurrent stress, 67,430 batches, 404,570 encoders, enc=547,328; Stage 3: 60s RC6 idle + 30s 4-worker burst wake, 22,513 batches, 135,068 encoders, enc=705,024; 0 GPU hangs, 0 GPURestart, 0 kernel panics). Per user confirmation on 2026-11-06, deployed R32-PCFIX27-PMAPFIX to internal NVMe /boot/EFI/OC and verified byte-for-byte SHA-256 readback.
milestones.limitation: Per explicit user instruction ('完成gpu后停止适配，更新仓库，以及推送到远端'), adaptation is stopped after completing GPU stability and endurance verification and deploying R32-PCFIX27-PMAPFIX to /boot/EFI/OC.
